_doc: Template for Chok daily commentary files. One file per (week, day):

_fields.carry: bridge from yesterday's portion - explains where today begins mid-subject
_fields.intro: simple explanation of today's subject matter
_fields.verses: our simple per-verse commentary (ref = 'c:v' within the book)
_fields.rashi: our simple commentary ON Rashi, with optional super-commentaries
